maya.activity: Wake up, stretch, and read the news in bed before getting dressed.
maya.intention: Start the day quietly and check transportation news before commuting.

maya.activity: Make coffee and a quick breakfast, pack lunch, and fill a water bottle.
maya.intention: Prepare food and drinks for the workday without making the morning complicated for the visiting relative.

maya.activity: Get dressed, collect work items, and leave the apartment with a brief check that the guest room and shared areas are comfortable.
maya.intention: Be ready to leave on time while making sure the visitor has what they need.
Travel to work and arrive prepared for the day.

maya.activity: Work at the city transportation department on transportation planning tasks and Wednesday site-visit preparation.
maya.intention: Handle the workday carefully before the afternoon site visit.

maya.activity: Eat the packed lunch and review the afternoon site-visit notes.
maya.intention: Take a practical midday break and prepare for changing traffic and weather conditions.

maya.activity: Continue work at the transportation department, including the afternoon site visit and follow-up notes.
maya.intention: Complete the site-visit work without letting unpredictable conditions derail the rest of the day.

maya.activity: Commute home and change clothes, put work items away, and decompress with tea.
maya.intention: Create a clean boundary between work and hosting the relative.
Clear my head after the site visit before returning to the social part of the day.

maya.activity: Return home, check in warmly with the visiting relative, and set out a simple drink while deciding on dinner.
maya.intention: Make the visitor feel included without turning the evening into a production.

maya.activity: Prepare a simple dinner and eat with the visiting relative at the dining table.
maya.intention: Offer an easy, welcoming meal while keeping the evening manageable on a workday.

maya.activity: Clear dinner things, wash the dishes, and wipe down the kitchen while keeping conversation easy.
maya.intention: Restore the kitchen without making the visitor feel dismissed or responsible for cleanup.

maya.activity: Sit with the visiting relative in the living room for a quieter visit, with the lights kept comfortable.
maya.intention: Give the relative relaxed company while allowing the day to wind down.

maya.activity: Read fiction and prepare clothes for tomorrow in the bedroom.
maya.intention: Keep my usual bedtime routine and recover some private quiet after hosting.

maya.activity: Put my phone on charge, place my reading glasses in the upper nightstand drawer, and go to sleep.
maya.intention: End the day with the bedroom reset and everything ready for morning.

daniel.activity: Wake up, brush my teeth, shower, and listen to a podcast while getting ready.
daniel.intention: Start the day calmly without disturbing the visiting relative.

daniel.activity: Grind coffee beans by hand, boil water, and make coffee at the kitchen counter.
daniel.intention: Make coffee before the morning gets busy.

daniel.activity: Make a quick breakfast and eat at the kitchen counter while talking with Maya and checking that the visitor has what they need.
daniel.intention: Be hospitable without making the morning feel like a formal event.

daniel.activity: Set up my laptop at the glass desk in bedroom 1, edit dialogue, attend remote production calls, and monitor audio with headphones.
daniel.intention: Work quietly while keeping bedroom 2 available for the guest.

daniel.activity: Make a quick lunch and eat standing at the kitchen counter, tasting as I go and leaving the tasting spoon on the sink side.
daniel.intention: Eat efficiently before the afternoon session.

daniel.activity: Continue editing and monitoring audio from the bedroom 1 desk, joining the remote studio session and keeping revision notes in writing.
daniel.intention: Protect a focused work block despite the unusual guest arrangement.

daniel.activity: Save the session, close the laptop, coil the cable, put the laptop and portable drive into my messenger bag, and play piano for ten minutes before leaving.
daniel.intention: Finish cleanly and decompress before the late studio session.

daniel.activity: Put on my work shoes and jacket, collect my keys and wallet, and head to the post-production studio.
daniel.intention: Leave on time without making Maya manage my departure.

daniel.activity: Work at the post-production studio on the late mix and final monitoring session.
daniel.intention: Handle the last-minute delivery work and get the mix into a reliable state.

daniel.activity: Return home, put my messenger bag beside the living room sofa, carry my phone to the bar cart, and drink water while checking in with Maya and the visitor.
daniel.intention: Re-enter quietly and make the guest feel acknowledged without starting a big hosting performance.

daniel.activity: Eat something simple in the living room and clear only the most visible kitchen items from earlier.
daniel.intention: Have a late dinner without creating another cooking project.

daniel.activity: Wind down quietly on the sectional, drink water, and check that the guest room and common areas are comfortable before going to bed.
daniel.intention: Make sure the visit is going smoothly while preserving a little quiet time with Maya.

daniel.activity: Brush my teeth, change into sleepwear, and get into bed.
daniel.intention: End the late workday and get enough rest for tomorrow.
